primary.title: Gold Steadies as Conflicting Iran Signals Cloud Path for Rates
primary.summary: Gold held a decline as conflicting signals on efforts to end the Iran war clouded the outlook for inflation and the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.

related.title: Gold Wavers as Traders Weigh US-Iran Talks, Fed Rate Path
related.summary: Gold wavered as traders assessed the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path and the status of negotiations to end the war in Iran.
